_comment: THE identity of the cluster this tree builds. One value, one place.
Everything network-shaped about the cluster is DERIVED from `clusterName`:
A SECOND, FEDERATABLE CLUSTER is a second checkout of this tree with a
different clusterName here. There is no allocator and no registry to ask:
distinct names derive distinct CIDRs and distinct cluster ids, which is what
Cilium ClusterMesh requires. See the module docstring for the collision bound
-- Cilium's cluster-id is 8 bits, so the derivation is collision-RESISTANT and
never collision-free, and the mitigation is detection plus renaming.
DELIBERATELY NOT INJECTABLE FROM THE FLASH MEDIUM. The Cilium values live in
checked-in YAML that ArgoCD reconciles from git; a per-USB cluster name could
not move them, so an injected name would put the CNI and the control plane on
different networks with nothing to say so. Changing the cluster identity is a
repo edit that `lint-cluster-cidr-agreement.ts` re-checks across all surfaces.
